title: thlaspi pulvinatum
intro: Thlaspi pulvinatum, commonly known as  Rock Cress, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family, characterized by its small, white, and fragrant flowers. It is used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Rock Cress include antimicrobial, anti-ulcer, and anti-anxiety effects, attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Thlaspi pulvinatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
